findings.kind: raw ASCII mathematical notation in item title
findings.source_text: title: "FISTA has an O(1/k^2) objective bound"
findings.rendered: The title visibly displays O(1/k^2) with literal caret/slash notation instead of a typeset rate.
findings.repair: Typeset the rate in the title, e.g. $O(1/k^2)$ or an equivalent title-safe math form.

optional_candidates.candidate: Show input nodes feeding primitive operation nodes and a scalar output, with any repeated parent slot drawn as a distinct edge. Overlay forward topological primal/tangent propagation and the reverse sweep seeded with output cotangent 1; show each local-transpose contribution accumulating at its parent. Check edge directions and repeated-slot addition against the text. The proof already establishes the recurrence, so the diagram is editorial only.
optional_candidates.status: optional, source-supported; no correctness claim relies on a diagram.

visual_summary.latex_and_mathmarkdown: Rendered formulas inspected at original resolution; no malformed LaTeX or math-output corruption confirmed. One confirmed literal ASCII exponent in a title is listed under findings.
visual_summary.tikz: Capture metadata for all assigned items reports zero TikZ; no TikZ output was present in the reviewed tiles.
visual_summary.scratch: No Scratch sections were identified in this lane.
visual_summary.reference_titles: No rendering defect from title/reference leakage was confirmed.
visual_summary.clipping: No unexpected clipping confirmed. Multi-tile items were reviewed one tile at a time; adjacent capture segments were visible on numbered tiles.
visual_summary.metadata: The category manifest separately records two strict YAML source-frontmatter blockers for items outside this lane. They are metadata parse blockers, not visual defects.
